description: Pins, not floats (audit T9): every image is tag+digest, every action a SHA, both lockfiles refreshed. This is the policy the Renovate app applies once it is installed on the repository: one grouped PR a week per area, security updates any time. Until then nothing reads this file and the pins move by hand.

customManagers.description: Images pulled by the dagger module (.dagger/main.go const block): <repo>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>
Images referenced by digest in workflow run: steps (Trivy for the SBOM)

dagger engine version in dagger.json. The CLI checksums and engine digest in .github/actions/setup-dagger are refreshed by hand in the same PR: a test fails until the action's version equals engineVersion

Riksarkivet/universalviewer4 commit the web image builds UV from (.docker/htrflow-web.dockerfile). The bun and node stages of that file are covered by the dockerfile manager; this ARG is not. Bumping it may need .docker/uv4-uv-html.patch re-derived, so it gets its own PR.

AI-Riksarkivet/htrflow commit the wrapper image builds its htrflow base from (ARG HTRFLOW_REF in .docker/htrflow-batch.dockerfile), on both architectures. Bumping it rebuilds that base, so it gets its own PR; when the new commit changes htrflow's pyproject.toml the image build refuses it until `make lock-htrflow-base` refreshes .docker/htrflow-base/ in the same PR.
Trivy image used by make scan-web and make scan-image (tag plus digest)

packageRules.description: Container images anywhere (dockerfiles, chart values, dagger module, workflows): one weekly PR
The htrflow commit the wrapper's base is built from: its own PR, the lock and the wrapper on top of it must be re-verified
torch/torchvision follow the cu128 index by hand (dockerfile comment); uv itself is a pin
The Universal Viewer fork commit: its own PR — the uv4-uv-html.patch may need re-deriving against it
GitHub Actions: SHA pins with the version comment kept; one weekly PR
dagger engine (dagger.json; setup-dagger follows by hand): its own PR, the module must be re-verified
Python dev tools (ruff, ty, pytest, moto) from the workspace lock
Python runtime deps of both members: grouped, patch+minor only; majors get their own PR
Campaign browser (bun.lock): one weekly PR, majors separate
